notes: Figures and rates are reproduced as reported in the supplied program-performance table. Blank wage cells are shown as Not reported; they do not represent zero wages.
An exit is not necessarily a graduation. Employment after exit is not necessarily employment in the field of study or placement by the school.
Post-exit quarter measures describe follow-up periods after a student leaves. The supplied table does not state a verification date or explain whether all follow-up periods were complete.

The supplied table does not give current counts for graduates, withdrawals, transfers, field-of-study placement, certification-exam attempts or passes, or average starting salary. Those figures cannot be inferred from these totals.

Reported outcomes describe the stated periods and do not guarantee a credential, job, or salary for an individual student. Contact info@mentoragile.com for reporting definitions and additional disclosures.
